correctness_gate: own per-shape oracle: torch reference must pass independent FP64 points; every candidate and final layout path must pass full torch FP32 and the same prepared independent FP64 points before timing
selection: lowest median graph-device latency among fully validated, successfully timed candidates within the fixed budget; not exhaustive optimality
device_timing: CUDA graph replay with external timing-event nodes around each logical operation on one non-default stream; capture/setup excluded
api_timing: separate eager execute_plan_at_index loop, preallocated buffers, host wall clock through stream synchronization; host feed separately recorded
layout_policy: logical NCHW dimensions with explicit strides; resident and caller_nchw paths separate; caller_nchw includes input and weight conversion every invocation plus output restoration, all buffers preallocated
statistics: 5x30 descriptive batch summaries; no confidence or cross-session claim
